events.title: Care Without Crossing Open House
events.description: Come tour the mobile clinic, step inside, and meet the team from Peninsula Community Health Services. Join the fun, get registered, win a basket of Island Favorites, kids table with crafts, and snacks. 11AM–2PM. On-island appointments twice a month beginning mid-September.

events.title: Bingo at the Lakeshore
events.description: Join us for community bingo at the Lakeshore. All proceeds support AIHA's mobile clinic launch.
